snippet.title: Gyruss for the Atari 2600
snippet.description:
Sure, it's an easy game...a quite easy game and it becomes repetitive.

But damn, this is a quite fun and quite addictive game. And isn't that what is important in games?

Also, the quality of the music is insane...in an awesome way. The only other game where I know that it has such a quality when it comes to Atari 2600 music is Pitfall II.
